operations.description: Call PlayerProfileScanner(this, 0) — the only side effect of the function; the second argument is the literal 0.
Return 0 unconditionally after the scanner call.

unresolved: Meaning of the literal 0 passed to PlayerProfileScanner (flag, mode, or selector) is not derivable from this packet.
